title: He aha ka manaʻo o A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, a me C2?
invitation: ʻIke ʻia kēia mau code pae ma nā puke, nā papa, nā hōʻike, nā app, a me nā profile ʻōlelo a puni ka honua. Ma ʻaneʻi, wehewehe mākou i ko lākou manaʻo maoli, ke kumu e hiki ai i kou mau mākau ke noho ma nā pae like ʻole, a me ke ʻano a Gef e hoʻohana ai iā lākou.
summary: Hoʻohana ʻo Gef iā CEFR A1–C2 ma ke ʻano he palapala ʻāina like no ka mākaukau ʻōlelo, mālama iā Pre-A1 no nā ʻanuʻu mua, a hoʻohui ma luna o C2 i kāna koho ponoʻī ‘Mākaukau loa / Pae ʻōlelo makuahine’. Hiki ke ʻokoʻa kou mākaukau maoli ma ka heluhelu, hoʻolohe, ʻōlelo, kākau, launa, a me mediation.

blocks.title: He palapala ʻāina like no ka mākaukau ʻōlelo
blocks.text: ʻO A1 a hiki i C2 mai ka Common European Framework of Reference for Languages, ʻo CEFR. Hāʻawi ia i nā haumāna, kumu, kula, hōʻike, a me nā mea paʻi i ala like e kamaʻilio ai no ka mākaukau ʻōlelo. ʻAʻole ʻo A a me B he grade kula, a ʻaʻole manaʻo ʻo Gef he ala vocabulary a grammar like ko nā ʻōlelo a pau.

blocks.title: Pre-A1 · Nā ʻanuʻu mua
blocks.text: ʻO Pre-A1 ka wā ma mua o A1. Hiki paha iā ʻoe ke ʻike i kekahi mau huaʻōlelo, hōʻailona, leo, inoa, helu, a i ʻole ʻōlelo i hoʻopaʻanaʻau ʻia, akā pono nō paha ka nui o ke kōkua. Aia ʻo Pre-A1 i nā mea CEFR hou. Ma ka scale self-rating maʻalahi a Gef, ʻo ke kikowaena ka ʻike ʻole, a ʻo A1 ka ʻanuʻu mua ma waho.

blocks.title: A1 · Mea hoʻomaka
blocks.text: Ma A1 hiki iā ʻoe ke hana i nā mea pono me ka ʻōlelo liʻiliʻi ma nā kūlana kamaʻāina a maopopo. Hiki iā ʻoe ke hoʻomaopopo i nā mea pōkole a maʻalahi a hoʻololi i ka ʻike kumu. ʻO ka neʻe ʻana i A2 ka emi ʻana o ka hilinaʻi i nā ʻōlelo i hoʻopaʻanaʻau ʻia a me ka mālama ʻana i nā kūlana o kēlā me kēia lā ma kou iho.

blocks.title: A2 · Kēlā me kēia lā
blocks.text: Ma A2, hoʻomaka ka ʻōlelo e lawa no nā mea o kēlā me kēia lā: poʻe, wahi, hana a kula paha, kūʻai, huakaʻi, manawa, a me nā pono koke. ʻO ka neʻe ʻana i B1 ka hoʻopili ʻana i nā manaʻo ma nā māhele lōʻihi, ka wehewehe ʻana i nā kumu maʻalahi, a me ka mālama ʻana i nā kūlana paʻakikī ke wānana.

blocks.title: B1 · Kūʻokoʻa
blocks.text: Ma B1 hiki iā ʻoe ke mālama i nā kūlana maʻamau he nui me ka hoʻolālā ʻole i kēlā me kēia ʻōlelo ma mua. Hiki iā ʻoe ke hahai i ka manaʻo nui o ka ʻōlelo maopopo a lōʻihi aʻe, a kamaʻilio pili no ka ʻike, nā hoʻolālā, nā makemake, nā manaʻo, a me nā pilikia. Pono ʻo B2 i ka laulā, kikoʻī, wikiwiki, a me ka hoʻomalu hou aʻe.

blocks.title: B2 · Kūʻokoʻa ikaika
blocks.text: Ma B2 hiki iā ʻoe ke komo pono i ke kamaʻilio lōʻihi, kūkākūkā i nā manaʻo concrete a abstract, a hana ma nā kūlana kaiāulu, kula kiʻekiʻe, a ʻoihana he nui. ʻO ka neʻe ʻana i C1 ka hoʻomalu finer i ka inference, nuance, register, hoʻonohonoho, a me style.

blocks.title: C1 · Kiʻekiʻe
blocks.text: Ma C1 lilo ka ʻōlelo i mea hana loli. Hiki iā ʻoe ke mālama i nā mea paʻakikī, hoʻomaopopo i ka manaʻo i ʻōlelo ʻole ʻia ma ke ʻano pololei, a hoʻololi i ka tone a me style e kūlike me ke kūlana. ʻO ka neʻe ʻana i C2 he mea pili i ka hohonu, nā ʻokoʻa liʻiliʻi, reformulation wikiwiki, nā māla kūikawā, a me ka hoʻomalu pololei ma mua o kahi papa grammar hope loa.

blocks.title: C2 · Mākaukau kiʻekiʻe loa
blocks.text: ʻO C2 ka pae kuhikuhi like kiʻekiʻe loa o CEFR. Hiki i ka mea C2 ke mālama i ka ʻōlelo paʻakikī loa me ka hoʻomalu kikoʻī i ka manaʻo, kūkulu, implication, a me style. ʻAʻole ʻo C2 ka ʻike ʻana i nā huaʻōlelo a pau, ka hewa ʻole mau, a i ʻole ka lilo ʻana i mea ʻōlelo makuahine ma ke ʻano automatic.

blocks.title: Mākaukau loa / Pae ʻōlelo makuahine · Ka self-description kiʻekiʻe loa a Gef
blocks.text: Hoʻohui ʻo Gef ma luna o C2 i kāna koho Mākaukau loa / Pae ʻōlelo makuahine. ʻAʻole kēia he CEFR C3 a ʻaʻole he palapala hōʻoia official. Hiki i ka mea ʻaʻole native speaker ke koho inā kūlike kona mākaukau maoli ma kēlā skill me ka mea makua native speaker mākaukau loa. Wehewehe ʻo Gef i ka mākaukau, ʻaʻole ke kūpuna a i ʻole kumu hānau.

blocks.title: He shape kou mākaukau ʻōlelo, ʻaʻole hoʻokahi leka
blocks.text: Hiki i nā skill ʻeono ke ʻokoʻa: Heluhelu, Hoʻolohe, ʻŌlelo, Kākau, Interaction, a me Mediation. Hiki iā ʻoe ke C1 ma ka heluhelu, B2 ma ka hoʻolohe, a A2 ma ka ʻōlelo. Hōʻike ka radar graph me nā axis ʻeono i kēia mau ʻokoʻa.

blocks.title: ʻAʻole he checklist ka pae no nā lesson mua a pau
blocks.text: ʻAʻole ulu like ka aʻo ʻōlelo. Hiki iā ʻoe ke nele i kekahi grammar principle mua a loaʻa ka advanced ability ma kahi ʻē aʻe. Hoʻohana ʻo Gef i ka pae e wehewehe i ka pattern laulā o kāu mea hiki ke hana; ʻaʻole ʻo B2 ka pau pono ʻana o nā lesson A1 a me A2 a pau.

blocks.title: Ke ana nei ʻo Gef i ka Reading i kēia manawa, ʻaʻole ka hexagon holoʻokoʻa
blocks.text: He reading-first app ʻo Gef i kēia manawa. Hiki iā ʻoe ke self-report i nā skill ʻeono, akā pono ka evidence mai nā puke, reading lessons, comprehension, a me dictionary use e hoʻololi wale i ka Reading estimate. ʻAʻole pono ʻo Gef e infer i Speaking, Listening, Writing, Interaction, a i ʻole Mediation mai ka heluhelu ʻana.

blocks.title: ʻO ka label A2 o ka puke e ʻōlelo ana no ka puke
blocks.text: Inā label ʻo Gef i kahi puke A2, he reading-difficulty signal kēlā. ʻO ka hoʻopau ʻana i ka puke he evidence no Reading, akā ʻaʻole ia e hōʻoia i nā skill ʻē aʻe a pau he A2. Pēlā nō nā test: e nānā i ka mea i ana maoli ʻia.

blocks.title: He aha ka mediation?
blocks.text: ʻO mediation ka kōkua ʻana i ka manaʻo e hele ma waena o kahi hakahaka. Aia i loko ka translation a me live interpreting, ka hōʻuluʻulu ʻana i kahi text paʻakikī, ka wehewehe ʻana i kahi idea me ka ʻōlelo maʻalahi, ka lawe ʻana i ka ʻike ma waena o ka poʻe ʻaʻohe ʻōlelo like, a i ʻole ka reformulation o kahi kūʻē i maopopo ai i nā ʻaoʻao ʻelua.

blocks.title: Hiki i ka course progress ke hāʻawi i clue pono
blocks.text: Hoʻopuka kekahi app i ka pilina o kā lākou course me CEFR. Duolingo Score: 0–29 A1, 30–59 A2, 60–99 B1, 100–129 B2, 130–160 C1/C2. He course progress kēia, ʻaʻole he independent test o nā skill a pau; mālama ʻo Gef i ka original score ma ke ʻano he evidence hoʻokahi.

blocks.title: Nui nā system pae ʻōlelo o ka honua
blocks.text: ʻAʻole ʻo CEFR ka system hoʻokahi. Hoʻohana ʻia ACTFL ma US language education, ILR 0–5 ma kekahi government context, CLB/NCLC ma Kanada, JLPT N5–N1 no ka ʻōlelo Kepanī, a HSK no Mandarin. ʻOkoʻa nā pahuhopu, no laila ʻaʻole manaʻo ʻo Gef he perfect one-to-one equivalent no kēlā me kēia label.

blocks.title: Laʻana: JLPT Kepanī
blocks.text: Mai Dekemaba 2025, hiki i kahi JLPT result i pass ke hōʻike i official CEFR reference level e pili ana i JLPT level a me total score. Akā ana ʻo JLPT i language knowledge, reading, listening; ʻaʻole speaking, writing, interaction. Pono ka mapping e pili wale i nā skill i ana maoli ʻia.

blocks.title: Ke loli nei ka HSK Pākē, no laila he mea nui ka version
blocks.text: He standardized Mandarin test ʻo HSK. He ʻeono levels ko HSK 2.0 a he pilina mōʻaukala me CEFR. Ua hoʻolālā ʻia HSK 3.0 hou me ʻekolu stages a ʻeiwa levels, akā ke hoʻomau nei ka transition 2026. Mālama ʻo Gef i ka HSK version a manaʻo i ka nine-level-to-CEFR conversion he estimate a hiki i ka official concordance.

blocks.title: ʻAʻole like ka framework me ka test
blocks.text: He framework ʻo CEFR no ka wehewehe ʻana i proficiency. Hiki i nā exams a me organizations ke align i nā results me ia. Pono ka score i context: nā skill i ana ʻia, pehea a i ka manawa hea i hana ʻia ai ka alignment, a official paha ka result a i ʻole estimate. ʻAʻole pono e hōʻike i kahi Gef estimate ma ke ʻano he official CEFR certificate.

blocks.title: ʻAʻohe universal A2 word count hoʻokahi
blocks.text: He mea nui ka vocabulary, akā ʻaʻole CEFR e define iā A1, A2, a B1 paha me hoʻokahi fixed word count. ʻOkoʻa nā ʻōlelo i ka word segmentation, writing system, compounds, morphology, a me ka hoʻonohonoho manaʻo. ʻAʻole hiki ke copy pololei i kahi English vocabulary estimate i nā ʻōlelo a pau.

blocks.title: Pehea ʻo Gef e hoʻohana ai i nā levels
blocks.text: Hoʻohana ʻo Gef iā CEFR A1–C2 ma ke ʻano he shared coordinates, Pre-A1 no first steps, a me kāna pae Mākaukau loa / Pae ʻōlelo makuahine ma luna. He reading difficulty ko nā puke, a hiki i profile ke mālama i nā skill values ʻeono. Wehewehe kaʻawale ka language-specific curriculum data i concepts, word senses, grammar, scripts, a me text types.

blocks.title: He estimate ka Gefstimate, ʻaʻole diploma
blocks.text: Inā hoʻohui ʻo Gef i repeated evidence i ka wā e hiki mai ana, hiki i ka English UI ke kapa i ka estimate he Gefstimate. ʻAʻole e koi ʻia kēlā wordplay i nā ʻōlelo ʻē aʻe. He evidence-based estimate ia no kekahi skill kikoʻī, ʻaʻole he official CEFR certificate, a pono e hiki iā Gef ke wehewehe i ka evidence i hoʻohana ʻia.

blocks.title: Pehea ʻoe e neʻe ai i ka level aʻe?
blocks.text: ʻAʻole ma ka hoʻopiha ʻana i hoʻokahi magic progress bar. Hiki i future Gef estimates ke hoʻohui i lesson performance, difficulty o ka mea āu e heluhelu maikaʻi ai, help āu e pono ai, comprehension results, a me skill-related evidence ʻē aʻe. Kōkua ka vocabulary a me grammar, akā ʻaʻole lāua ka gate hoʻokahi. ʻAʻole pono i hoʻokahi puke maʻalahi ke hāpai automatic iā ʻoe, a ʻaʻole pono i hoʻokahi lā paʻakikī ke hoʻohaʻahaʻa automatic iā ʻoe.

blocks.title: Ma ka pōkole
blocks.description: Zero ka manaʻo ʻaʻohe ʻike i kēia manawa. ʻO Pre-A1 nā ʻanuʻu mua. Kūkulu ʻo A1 a me A2 i ka basic everyday ability. Hōʻike ʻo B1 a me B2 i ka independence e ulu ana. ʻO C1 a me C2 ka proficiency kiʻekiʻe, flexible, a precise. Hoʻohui ʻo Gef ma luna i kāna pae Mākaukau loa / Pae ʻōlelo makuahine. ʻO kou mākaukau maoli ka shape o nā skill ʻeono.
